en.headline: Saudel weakens over Guangdong inland; Signal No. 1 stays
en.dek: At 8pm Tropical Depression Saudel was about 280 km northeast of Hong Kong and is forecast to move west-southwest across eastern Guangdong while continuing to weaken.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal, No. 1 remained in force on Thursday evening. At 8pm Tropical Depression Saudel was estimated near 24.4 degrees north, 115.7 degrees east, about 280 kilometres northeast of Hong Kong.

The system is forecast to move west-southwest at about 12 kilometres per hour across the inland areas of eastern Guangdong and continue to weaken. The Observatory said it would cancel all tropical cyclone warning signals once Saudel weakens into a low-pressure area.

Under the combined influence of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, winds were occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory earlier indicated that a Strong Wind Signal No. 3 was unlikely given the relatively rapid weakening of the system.

zh.headline: 沙德爾於廣東內陸減弱 一號戒備信號維持
zh.dek: 下午8時熱帶低氣壓沙德爾位於本港東北約280公里，預料向西南偏西橫過廣東東部內陸並繼續減弱。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周四晚上繼續生效。下午8時，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾集結在北緯24.4度、東經115.7度附近，即香港東北約280公里。
預料系統向西南偏西移動，時速約12公里，橫過廣東東部內陸並繼續減弱。天文台指，當沙德爾減弱為低壓區時，會取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號。
受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台較早前表示，鑑於系統減弱較快，發出三號強風信號的機會不大。
